messages:
telemetry-bot: [ALERT] traces_ingest_errors: collector-east exporter write failures spiking >5%. Observed: missing child spans for service=payments-service from 2024-04-20T14:00:00Z. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/d/telemetry/traces?from=1710987600
oncall_jess: ack, looking into it
sam_platform: exporter to kafka 'traces-prod' showing repeated write timeouts: "err=write timeout after 30s" in collector logs around 14:02
lee_runtime: we rolled otel-collector v2.1.3 @ 13:55 with async-ack enabled to improve throughput
sam_platform: that async ack change means exporter acks are batched -> if kafka write fails we may drop span children while parent already committed upstream
eva_sre: can someone curl payments-service and confirm traceparent is preserved through sidecars?
mike_pmt: running quick test:
```
curl -v -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" https://payments.internal/_health
```
mike_pmt: response headers show Traceparent cleared by nginx-sidecar (proxy_set_header Traceparent ""); saw that in the last deploy's sidecar config diff: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/merge/PR-482
oncall_jess: wow, so header dropped at ingress -> collector sees parent but children created downstream lose linkage, combined with exporter flush races -> orphaned spans
lee_runtime: mitigation plan: 1) revert sidecar header change in infra repo 2) roll collector back to v2.1.2 or disable async-ack 3) increase exporter queue_size to 20000 temporarily 4) run canary at 10%
sam_platform: I'll open rollback PR now and bump queue via configmap canary
sam_platform: quick config snippet to patch:
```
exporters:
  kafka:
    max_queue_size: 20000
    write_timeout: 60s
```
oncall_jess: doing infra revert now (rolling restart on ingress-sidecars)
telemetry-bot: deploy: infra/sidecar-revert started by oncall_jess - https://deploys.redwood/12345
mike_pmt: revert merged, ingress pods restarting
lee_runtime: also patching collector config to disable async-ack on canary
oncall_jess: monitoring traces dashboard... error rate dropping
telemetry-bot: metric traces_ingest_errors back to 0.8% at 14:10
oncall_jess: children spans reappearing for payments-service in sampled traces, looks healthy
eva_sre: follow-up: add automated lint that prevents clearing Traceparent in nginx templates, and add an e2e test that validates header passthrough for traced requests
sam_platform: agreed, filing infra ticket and adding rollback flag in rollout UX so disabling async-ack is an easier toggle
oncall_jess: closing alert, will follow up in incident log
telemetry-bot: alert status: resolved
